savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Except to the extent that they may be inconsistent with this order, all determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements, and other actions made, issued, or entered into with respect to any function affected by this order and not revoked, superseded, or otherwise made inapplicable before the date of this order, shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or terminated by appropriate authority.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: A continuation clause for actions under functions the order affects; it reaches actions taken under EO 10746 (a superseded order listed in sec. 7(a)(4)).

transfer_provisions.quote: the functions conferred upon the President by Title I and IV of the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954 (7 U.S.C. 1691-1694; 1731-1736) are hereby delegated to the Secretary of Agriculture
transfer_provisions.note: Re-delegates the Act's functions; sec. 4(d)(4)-(5) restates the allocation of sec. 104(d) and (e) foreign currencies that EO 10746 had amended into EO 10560.

exceptions.quote: To the extent not heretofore superseded, the following-described orders and parts of orders are hereby superseded
exceptions.note: The supersession of EO 10560, 10685, 10708, 10746, 10799 (secs. 1-2), 10827, 10884 and part of 10893 is expressly limited to what had not been superseded earlier.

effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording appears (secs. 1-7 read in full); the supersession took effect on signing, January 5, 1961 (printed 26 FR 143-144, January 10, 1961).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:10746: sec. 7(a)(4) ('Executive Order No. 10746 of December 12, 1957'). EO 10746 is BLOCKED in this batch; this record is extra, written because EO 10900, not EO 12220, is the first named end of EO 10746.

conclusion: EO 10900 (signed 1961-01-05, 26 FR 143, PDF pages 3-4, read once in full) delegates the President's functions under the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954 (secs. 1-3), allocates the foreign currencies (sec. 4), reserves sec. 108 functions (sec. 5), defines terms (sec. 6) and in sec. 7(a) supersedes EO 10560, 10685, 10708, 10746, secs. 1-2 of EO 10799, EO 10827 and 10884 'to the extent not heretofore superseded'; sec. 7(b) continues actions taken under affected functions. Written as an extra record for the blocked EO 10746; not an ending instrument of any claim in this batch.
